# Annual billing only for teams of 20+ seats

## Context
Bergmann Logistik asked for 40 seats on annual billing.

## Decision
Teams with 20 or more seats are billed annually. Smaller teams keep monthly billing.

## Consequences
- The pricing page on the relaunched website needs a seat threshold.
